seo.seo_title: Websites, Google visibility and email | Norden Media UF
seo.seo_description: Website, your own web address, business email, visibility on Google and bookings that run themselves. We build and run it all, you skip the tech.

sidhuvud.t4: We build, run and update everything. You get a website that gets found, works and brings in customers, so you can spend your time on what you do best.

tjanster.t8: Fast, clear websites that work just as well on mobile. When needed, with booking, contact forms and customer login.
tjanster.t13: We register your web address (domain), handle all the settings and set up email with your business name.
tjanster.t17: We make your website easy to find on Google and in AI services such as ChatGPT, and set up your profile on Google Maps.
tjanster.t22: Customers book on the website themselves. Confirmations, reminders and mailings go out automatically, and everything is saved in your customer register.
tjanster.t25: We make sure everything is running, secure and up to date. You never have to think about web hosting, backups or updates.

what_is_included.t28: Whichever package you choose, you get a website built to be found, to be secure and to work on every screen.
what_is_included.t30: Just as clear on mobile, tablet and desktop. Most visitors arrive on their phone.
what_is_included.t32: Optimised images and clean code, so visitors do not have to wait and Google ranks you higher.
what_is_included.t34: The website is encrypted (https), which both visitors and Google expect.
what_is_included.t36: The right page titles and descriptions, and we submit the website to Google so that it is found sooner.
what_is_included.t38: Enquiries go straight to your inbox, with protection against spam.
what_is_included.t40: Forms that only collect what is needed, and a privacy policy tailored to you.
what_is_included.t42: The website is backed up regularly, so nothing is lost if something goes wrong.
what_is_included.t44: Clear contrast, readable text and a structure that works with screen readers.

automatisering.t47: When a customer books through the website, the system takes care of the rest. Everything is saved in the customer register and the right message goes out at the right time.
automatisering.t48: Try it yourself: book an appointment
automatisering.t60: Pick a service and time and press Book.
automatisering.t61: This is a demo. Nothing is sent.
automatisering.t63: Directly on the website, whenever it suits them. Evenings and weekends too.
automatisering.t65: The customer gets a confirmation with time, place and anything useful to know.
automatisering.t67: An automatic reminder before the visit reduces the risk of no-shows.
automatisering.t69: Contact details and history are kept in one place, with no double entry.
automatisering.t71: News, offers and follow-ups reach the right customers at the right moment.

sa_arbetar_vi.t125: You tell us what you need, and we take care of the rest. It usually takes three to six weeks from the first call to launch. How fast it goes depends on the size of your website and how often we can meet.
sa_arbetar_vi.t128: We get to know your business, your customers and how you work today. Then we know what the website needs to contain and what will make the biggest difference.
sa_arbetar_vi.t130: You get a fixed price for the build and a clear monthly fee, with what is included. Based on what you want, you get a short form about the content to fill in. After launch you can always change all the content yourselves, easily through your customer portal.
sa_arbetar_vi.t132: We write the copy, build the website on a test address that only you can see and connect the systems. You can follow the work all the way.
sa_arbetar_vi.t134: You review and approve the website. Then we move your web address and email and publish it, so you show up on Google from day one.
sa_arbetar_vi.t136: We keep the website running, secure and up to date, and help you whenever something needs changing. With the Sarek and Kebne packages you also get a monthly report with suggested improvements.
